name: GeoViewer_data_extractor
core_conversions: Native Model.ptd WellTraceSubject names and well-head XY coordinates to CSV
Validated native Points3 and Polygons3 LZ4/BXML coordinates to CSV
Validated native trajectory-provider BXML records to CSV
Native well-top rows after Petrel ASCII XYZ calibration
Native FloatWellLog continuous curves to LAS/CSV with original MD, values and nulls
Native IntWellLog categorical/boundary records to CSV with codes and null flags
Validated native RegValGrid2 surface arrays to XYZ/CSV/ZMAP and explicit ValGrid2 meshes to XYZ/CSV with definition masks
Observed Commands workflow definitions to readable JSON; no execution or native re-import
native_boundary: Observed LZ4/BXML object versions only; unit resolution is limited to non-customized Metric. Validated numeric grids can export with unresolved units; geometry/layout gates remain strict. CRS remains unresolved.
empty_output_policy: domain folders and zero-row artifacts are omitted
author: Ahmed Saher Nouh
purpose: Recover supported Petrel binary/native payloads into open formats; companion reformatting is secondary

binary_file_conversions.discovery: selected store plus exact native UUID links and external reference inventory

companion_conversions: Shapefile to CSV plus GeoJSON with explicit coordinate columns
Petrel Well Tops ASCII to structured CSV

seismic_integrity.fast_mode: file state plus complete numerical conversion QC; no source SHA-256 claim

modern_validation_priority: 2023/2024 and later through observed profiles; primary supplied fixture records 2024.5.0
